Q4872580.note: The location represents the Toverud farm battlefield sector, using the municipality's map marker for the 1908 Toverudstøtta beside the farm. Municipal history identifies the farm and Toverudsletta as the combat area, independently of the later memorial. This is a sector reference, not an exact 1808 position or a claim that the stone marks the entire engagement. Chronology remains uncertain: Store norske leksikon gives 19 April 1808, whereas the municipality-published Rømskog history gives 20 April. This location-only review preserves the existing start 19 April and end 20 April; it does not independently establish that combat lasted across both dates, and does not create an interval to reconcile the disagreement. No calendar conversion is inferred.
